versions.changelog: Made commute routing deterministic for consistent, reproducible commuting flows that drop occasional implausibly-long trips.
Added hospital and military-base demand to the Lithuanian maps, refreshed Estonian and Latvian road networks, and fixed workplace counts and over-drawn foundations.
Added per-building foundation depth and refined coastal seafloor to the Estonian maps, plus hospital and military-base demand, and fixed implausibly tall buildings.
Added the first Estonian maps — Tallinn, Tartu, Pärnu, and Ida-Viru — with census-based residents, workers, commute calibration, and a full range of demand points.
